## Verdict on the claim(s)
**C1 CONFIRMED** for all four repos at pinned SHAs.

No production code path invokes an LLM/VLM to judge an already-produced conversion output against the source document per page/chunk/unit.

- **grobid:** CRF Wapiti + optional DeLFT BidLSTM/SciBERT sequence labelling produces TEI directly; no OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/vLLM client code in grobid-core/src/main. Doc hit doc/Grobid-service.md:137 mentions feeding TEI to an LLM downstream (consumer, not invoker). CRF model.wapiti files contain openai.com URLs as embedded training features (string-only, not API calls).
- **PDF-Extract-Kit:** YOLO/LayoutLMv3/PaddleOCR/UniMERNet/StructEqTable extraction models only; vllm appears only in Sphinx autodoc_mock_imports (docs/en/conf.py:102-103). No verification lane.
- **pymupdf4llm:** Deterministic PDF to Markdown via PyMuPDF (+ optional layout/OCR); LLM API calls exist only in examples/ (examples/GUI/browser-app.py:109 ChatOpenAI; examples/country-capitals/country-capitals.py:28,96 OpenAI completions demo). Production src/ has zero LLM client imports.
- **PyMuPDF:** PDF engine library; LLM hits are README marketing for pymupdf4llm sibling package and PyObject_CallMethod* false positives (invoke substring). Zero LLM invocation sites.

## Coverage gaps
None. All four clones present at pinned SHAs; full-repo rg covered every file (including training corpora, lexicons, binary-adjacent text).

## What could still hide a counterexample
- Runtime-loaded plugins or optional deps not referenced by string in repo (none observed; grobid DeLFT is JNI to Python delft, still not generative LLM).
- External services called only by URL without pattern keywords (grobid REST returns TEI; no judge endpoint).
- Submodule or gitignored paths (not present in these clones at pinned SHAs).
